svg.title: Great One of the Night of Time: The Universe · Tau · Earth and Saturn (Book T deck, linocut)
svg.desc: A linocut printing of the full imagery. Book T gives the Keys their meanings only, no picture. Drawn from the Key's title and the figure the tradition gives it, as a symbol (no faces): a figure within the elliptical wreath, and the four Kerubim at the corners (man, eagle, bull, lion); Earth and Saturn. Book T (1912): "The matter itself. Synthesis, world, kingdom. Usually denotes actual subject of question, and therefore depends entirely on accompanying cards." Parts drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); printed by scripts/build_book_t_linocut.py.
